privacy.metaDesc: How A. Subramaniam collects, uses and protects your personal information.
privacy.title: Privacy policy

sections.p: When you fill a form, call or message, we may collect your name, phone number, email and details of your enquiry.
Only to reply to your enquiry and to help with insurance or property services you ask about. We do not sell your information.
With your consent, details may be shared with the relevant insurer to process a proposal or claim.
Your information is stored securely and only people who need it to help you can see it.
You can ask to see, correct or delete your information at any time by contacting us.
For privacy questions, please use the contact page.

terms.metaDesc: Terms of use for this website.
terms.title: Terms of use

sections.p: This website gives general information about insurance and property services offered by A. Subramaniam.
Information here is general guidance only. It is not a quote, an offer or policy advice. Cover is subject to the insurer's policy terms.
Insurance is the subject matter of solicitation. Please read the policy wording and sales brochure carefully before buying.
Listing details are shared in good faith. Please verify documents, approvals and prices before any purchase.
These terms may be updated from time to time. The latest version will be on this page.
